turns.question: For leads that turned into a booking in September 2026, what was the median number of days from lead creation to booking?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median days from lead creation to booking; the closest are bookings (54 in 1-30 Sep 2026), the lead-to-booking rate (38.6% of leads created in September booked within 30 days) and leads. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
